title: JFK on the Harvard astronomy department's board of overseers
summary: Beatriz Villarroel tells of JFK on the Harvard astronomy department's board of overseers, about 1950s at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: JFK was the on the board of overseers for the astronomer department.

plain: An astronomer named Beatriz Villarroel says that in the 1950s John F. Kennedy, later US president, sat on the board of overseers for the astronomy department at Harvard University. She credits this to the notes of Stanton Friedman, a UFO researcher. It comes up because it would tie a future president to the very department where, in a related story, old photographic plates of the sky are said to have been destroyed.
